parallels.note: I will pursue my enemies, and overtake them. I won’t turn away until they are consumed.

translations.web: I have pursued my enemies and destroyed them. I didn’t turn again until they were consumed.
translations.bsb: I pursued my enemies and destroyed them; I did not turn back until they were consumed.
translations.kjv: I have pursued mine enemies, and destroyed them; and turned not again until I had consumed them.
